items.subject: halftone-arc
items.notes: Hex-grid Mint #00FAB3 dots on an arc band; dots shrink toward the band edges and ends. Transparent; made for Navy grounds (Mint dots are too faint on white). SVG is the vector source (2,381 circles). Built locally (Pillow), v2 repaint of the v1 geometry.

items.name: Fine grain tile
items.subject: grain
items.notes: Tileable luminance noise (wrap-safe), black/white pixels at up to ~12.5% alpha. Use as background-repeat at 1x; lower opacity further on light grounds. Built locally; colourless, so unchanged from v1 (the v2 build is pixel-identical).

items.name: Violet to Navy ground
items.subject: ground-violet-navy
items.notes: Flat diagonal gradient, Ultra Violet #6203D0 top-left through Navy #020257 to Void #010138, light grain. The ground of the violet variant (replaces the v1 violet-streaks texture: no streaks, bokeh or glow). Built locally.
